headline: A concern-led skincare brand, built from identity to checkout.
summary: Brand identity, a Shopify store built around skin concerns and kits, Pixel and Conversions API tracking, Meta ad creative and 300 Instagram copy variations for Kitcoz (Elvey Essentials).
challenge: Kitcoz is a D2C skincare brand from Elvey Essentials. It needed to launch with a distinctive identity, a store built around skin concerns and product kits rather than a flat catalogue, and advertising that could be tracked accurately from the first rupee.
Products were already listed on Amazon, so the store also had to absorb that catalogue cleanly.

workstreams.title: Brand identity
workstreams.text: A teal colour system, a serif-plus-sans typography pairing, concern-led navigation and a brand manifesto that gave the store and the ads one voice.

workstreams.title: Shopify development
workstreams.text: The initial build and an Amazon-to-Shopify product migration, with custom sections: a combo-kit selector, concern-based collection filters, a pincode checker, product carousels and a cart drawer with coupons. GoKwik checkout integration and cash-on-delivery configuration.

workstreams.title: Tracking
workstreams.text: Meta Pixel and Conversions API setup with attribution troubleshooting, so campaign decisions were made on real purchase data.

workstreams.title: Meta ads
workstreams.text: A nine-kit creative pack and campaign structure, with extensive ad copy variations for testing.

workstreams.title: Content
workstreams.text: 300 Instagram copy variations, each with a unique AI image direction, giving the brand months of on-brand content.

results: Conversion rate, kit AOV, ROAS, checkout completion and COD-versus-prepaid share are published once confirmed from Shopify and Meta reports.

meta.title: Kitcoz case study — D2C skincare brand & Shopify | gaa-tha
meta.description: How gaa-tha built Kitcoz from brand identity to a concern-led Shopify store with kit selector, GoKwik checkout, Pixel/CAPI tracking and Meta ad creative.
